Market today: The 2-year yield jumping to its highest since January 2025 on a hot jobs report is the real driver, signaling potential Fed rate hikes and pressuring growth names. This is exactly what hurts your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin.
Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL/TRIM candidate, down 53.92%. SPAL is also a SELL/TRIM, down 33.48%. Both are leveraged ETFs that decay, and your margin amplifies these drops.
Watch: Keep an eye on Micron (MU) news, as they're doubling down on AI memory chips. Also, watch Tesla's reaction to the Cybercab launch.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and watching for any signs of capitulation or recovery in your core tech holdings.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this position given the 53.92% loss and leveraged decay, especially with rising rate fears.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF due to the 33.48% loss and inherent decay.
No new buys today - hold and watch
